scope: Workflow-defined technical validation rules; not biological detection limits, prevalence thresholds, or taxonomic criteria

fragment_selection.duplicate_sensitivity: report both preduplicate and samtools-markdup nonduplicate results

candidate_fragment_support.interpretation: Independent technical support excludes a run that is the smaller member of either a predeclared shadow_suspect comparison or a comparison with insufficient fingerprints for shadow assessment. Warning-shadow runs remain separately flagged. This rule is not evidence of independent infection.

cross_run_exact_fragment_shadow_qc.interpretation: A suspect result prevents treating the smaller run as independent support. It does not prove index hopping or contamination.

de_novo_recovery.assembly_input: complete paired FASTQ with no candidate bait, mapping seed, or target read selection
de_novo_recovery.candidate_support_rule: at least one source-run recovery and at least one non-source-run recovery

publication_gate.claim_boundary: Partial Picornavirales-like RdRP-containing sequence clusters only; no species, host infection, phenotype association, replication, pathogenicity, or transmission claim
